_comment: Copy to C:\ProgramData\infuse-deploy\config.json and fill in from the discovery report. Contains no secrets - safe to keep in version control if you want.
_requireSignedCommits: Set true only AFTER you have set up commit signing and imported your public key into the service account's GPG keyring. Until then a true value here blocks every deploy.
_paths: Absolute paths, because a Windows service does not inherit your interactive PATH. Fill these from the Toolchain section of the discovery report.
